P.name: More Sparkles!
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} After casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Zoe''' empowers her next {{tip|basic attack}}<!--not on-hit?--> or ''{{ai|Spell Thief|Zoe}}'' bolt within 5 seconds to become {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}} and deal {{pp|16; then +4*x for 5; then +6*x for 5; then +8*x for 3; then +10*x for 6|color=magic damage|formula=16 base, then +4 per level until level 6, then +6 per level until level 11, then +8 per level until level 14, then +10 per level}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.

Q.name: Paddle Star!
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zoe''' shoots a star in the target direction that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies hit. The '''total''' damage is increased by {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|0 to 150 for 7|800;950;1350;1650;1950;2250;2550}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{pp|2; then +2*x for 8; then +3*x for 4; then +4*x for 7|formula=2 base, then +2 per level until 9, then +3 per level until 13, then +4 per level}} (+ {{ap|50 to 170}}) {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{pp|2*2.5; then +(2*2.5)*x for 8; then +(3*2.5)*x for 4; then +(4*2.5)*x for 7|formula=250% of minimum}} (+ {{ap|50*2.5 to 170*2.5}}) {{as|(+ 150% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: The star lingers at maximum range for 1 second, during which ''Paddle Star!'' can be recast after {{fd|0.25}} seconds in the duration.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Zoe''' redirects the star in the target path, empowering it with increased speed and radius, and resetting its damage modifier on cast. The redirected star can travel until it reaches 800-units outbound from '''Zoe'''.
Q.description4: ''Paddle Star!'s recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

W.name: Spell Thief
W.description: {{sbc|Passive - Wheeeee:}} Whenever '''Zoe''' casts ''Spell Thief'' or a summoner spell, she gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a duration, and summons three bolts that orbit her for the next 10 seconds.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|30 to 70}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed Duration|{{ap|2 to 3}} seconds}}
W.description2: If '''Zoe''' is not affected by {{tip|complete crowd control}}, she shoots one bolt at a time at the nearest non-{{tip|sleep|sleeping}} enemy in range, prioritizing her attack target, dealing {{as|magic damage}} with each bolt.
W.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Bolt|{{ap|15 to 55}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|15*3 to 55*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*3}}% AP)}}}}
W.description3: {{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever an enemy champion casts a {{tt|specific|See notes for applicable spells/item actives}} {{ccib|Summoner spell icon.png|summoner spell}} or {{ccib|Active ability item icon.svg|Active ability items|item active}}, regardless of distance, they drop the corresponding ''{{as|{{ccib|Spell Thief Minimap.png||Spell Shard}}|armor}}'' onto the ground that grants {{tip|sight}} over a 100-radius area and remains for 40 seconds. Enemy {{tip|minions}} have a 10% chance to spawn with a {{tt|random ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}''|See notes for applicable spells/actives}} that drops and remains for 20 seconds if '''Zoe''' kills them. Allied champions that kill them will cause the ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}'' to drop only if '''Zoe''' is nearby.
W.description4: '''Zoe''' can collect a ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}'' by moving directly onto it, holding it for up to 60 seconds. Collecting a new ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}'' replaces the current one.
W.description5: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zoe''' mimics the active effect of the collected ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}''.

E.name: Sleepy Trouble Bubble
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zoe''' kicks a bubble in the target direction that bursts upon the first enemy hit, otherwise lingering at maximum range while slightly bouncing forward over 1 second, then becoming a trap for 5 seconds that bursts upon contact with an enemy. The bubble can move through [[terrain]] only once, but travels the entire distance as '''bonus''' range, and will fall short if it would enter terrain again.
E.description2: The burst deals {{as|magic damage}} to the target and inflicts them with {{tip|drowsy}} for {{fd|1.4}} seconds, which gradually {{tip|slows}} them until they fall {{tip|sleep|asleep}} for {{fd|2.25}} seconds. While the target is {{tip|sleep|asleep}}, they are inflicted with {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|30% magic resistance reduction}}}}.
E.description3: The next instance of non-{{tip|persistent damage|persistent}} damage from {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monsters}} or {{tip|turrets}} against the {{tip|sleep|sleeping}} target consumes the debuff to deal {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} equal to the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt, capped at ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble's'' damage. This '''bonus''' damage may also be applied within 1 second of the {{tip|sleep}} ending, if the debuff was not consumed.
E.leveling3: {{st|Bonus Damage Cap|{{ap|70 to 230}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}|Maximum Mixed Damage|{{ap|140 to 460}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}
E.description4: ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble'' refunds a percentage of its cooldown if the bubble hits an enemy champion.

R.name: Portal Jump
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} After a {{tt|{{fd|0.15}}-second delay|From the end of the cast time, blink occurs after 0.4 seconds from the start of cast}}, '''Zoe''' {{tip|blinks}} in the target direction and remains there for {{tt|{{fd|0.95}} seconds to {{fd|1.25}} seconds|See notes}}, during which she sets her {{as|movement speed}} to a {{as|static 0|ms}} and has {{tip|unobstructed vision}}. Afterwards, she {{tip|blinks}} back to her casting position.
R.description2: ''Portal Jump {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Zoe's''' basic attack timer. '''Zoe''' {{tt|briefly|See notes}} becomes {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} after casting Portal Jump as well as after blinking back.''
